# statusdrift_api_key (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_api_key" "cicd" {
  name            = "CI/CD Pipeline Key"
  expires_in_days = 180

  permissions = {
    monitor = {
      create = true
      read   = true
      update = true
      delete = false
    }
    tag = {
      read = true
    }
    status_page = {
      read = true
    }
  }
}

output "api_key_value" {
  value     = statusdrift_api_key.cicd.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the API key (max 255 characters).

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Number of days until the API key expires. Only used at creation time. Changing this value forces resource recreation. Omit for a non-expiring key.
- `permissions` (Attributes) Permissions granted to this API key. Each resource type has create, read, update, and delete booleans. Omitted resources default to all false. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date/time the API key was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration date/time of the API key in ISO 8601 format, or null if it does not expire.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the API key.
- `is_expired` (Boolean) Whether the API key has expired.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The full API key value. Only available after creation; cannot be retrieved later. Will be null after import.
- `key_prefix` (String) The first 12 characters of the API key, used for identification.
- `last_used_at` (String) The date/time the API key was last used for authentication, in ISO 8601 format.
